construction: Reuse eight 2048-point global batches from geometry/horizon probe, seed 991738; no focused loss in gradient.
selection: Lowest global physics selection loss, with unchanged baseline available.
audit: Reuse separate seed 991740 global and focused physics pools; neither constructs/selects directions.
normalization: Every direction matches saved-Adam L2 displacement for that checkpoint/batch; natural restart step magnitude is not tested.
suppressed_m: Set incoming first moment to zero; retain saved second moment, clock and usual beta1 update.
swapped_m: Borrow only incoming first moment from other checkpoint; keep current weights, gradient, second moment and clock.
fresh_adam: Zero both moments and restart clock at zero; normalize resulting first-step direction.
reference_usage: Evaluation-only final-time MAE/half-MSE gradients and finite-step development accuracy; never direction construction or selection.
